verdicts.use: Use: fits the rules; build it in the phase shown
verdicts.later: Later: useful, but for a later phase or only after a check
verdicts.have: Already decided or in the app
verdicts.skip: Skip: terms, coverage, cost or a dead service rule it out

items.name: Open-Meteo (forecast + ERA5 archive)
items.why: Keyless, 16-day forecast plus 10-year 'typical' values; tested on 7 cities, 220 calls, 0 errors after fixes. Free tier is non-commercial only, so switch or pay before phase 20.
items.terms: Non-commercial on free (verified); data CC BY 4.0; historical/climate need the Professional plan commercially

items.name: MET Norway Locationforecast
items.why: Free including commercial use; global; ~9.5 days. The forecast to move to before monetising.
items.terms: NLOD 2.0 + CC BY 4.0, commercial OK; identifying User-Agent; honour Expires; 4-decimal coords

items.name: Meteostat (bulk monthly CSV)
items.why: Station monthly normals for the ~40 curated cities' climate tags; within 0.4–1.4 °C of ERA5 for Lisbon; stays free after monetising.

items.name: date-holidays (npm library)
items.why: Offline, any year, lunar/Islamic dates; found every expected holiday in 8 trips. India has fixed dates only (no Diwali, Holi, Eid).
items.terms: ISC code, CC BY-SA 3.0 data (credit line)

items.name: Frankfurter
items.why: Keyless ECB rates; commercial use stated. Only ~30 currencies (no MAD, VND, AED).
items.terms: 'free for commercial use? Yes' (verified); cite the ECB

items.name: Currency-api (fawazahmed0)
items.why: Static JSON on jsDelivr, 340 currencies; fills Frankfurter's gaps; within 0.5% of it.

items.name: Wikipedia / Wikivoyage REST summary
items.why: Found all 8 test cities; short travel-focused intro for the trip card.
items.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0, commercial OK; credit + link + 'shortened'; identifying UA (10 req/min without one)

items.name: FOSSGIS OSRM foot / Valhalla (OSM)
items.why: Real walking times, keyless, ~50–130 ms; allowed while routing is a minor part of a low-traffic app.
items.terms: 1 req/s; OSM credit + 'fix the map' link; commercial only if not a substantial part (verified)

items.name: GeoNames cities15000 dump
items.why: ~25K cities with time zones in Postgres (pg_trgm) for the 'Where to?' picker. Nominatim forbids autocomplete.
items.terms: CC BY 4.0, commercial OK; credit GeoNames

items.name: Nominatim
items.why: Already used server-side for pins at under 1 req/s. Never for type-ahead.
items.terms: Autocomplete strictly forbidden (verified); 1 req/s; cache results

items.name: Foursquare Places API
items.why: In the app (src/lib/places.ts) on the deprecated v3 endpoint. Free tier cut to 500 calls/month; hours and ratings are Premium.
items.terms: 0–500 free Pro calls/month since 1 Jun 2026; v3 deprecated 15 May 2026 (verified)

items.name: Unsplash / Pexels
items.why: Already researched in phase 16 (DESIGN-RESEARCH.md); curated set first, API fallback deferred (Q34).

items.name: OpenRouter
items.why: Already chosen for the AI phase (Q28).

items.name: UK FCDO travel advice (GOV.UK Content API)
items.why: Per-country alert status and 'getting help' (emergency numbers).
items.terms: OGL v3, commercial OK; keep fresh

items.name: Nager.Date
items.why: Good where covered, but no India/Thailand/UAE and commercial use needs sponsorship. Fallback only.
items.terms: 'For commercial purposes we require active sponsorship' (verified)

items.name: Geoapify (routing, autocomplete, places)
items.why: Keyed upgrade path once FOSSGIS no longer fits; commercial and storage allowed.
items.terms: 3,000 credits/day free; storing allowed with attribution

items.name: openrouteservice (HeiGIT)
items.why: Keyed alternative. Old host api.openrouteservice.org shuts 2–6 Nov 2026.

items.name: Overpass API (OSM)
items.why: OSM opening hours on demand. Storing them on FSQ places risks ODbL share-alike.
items.terms: ~100 queries/day for regular use; commercial should self-host

items.name: ExchangeRate-API open endpoint
items.why: Works (166 currencies) but requires a visible attribution link.

items.name: OurAirports data
items.why: IATA codes for Gate Board passes (e.g. LIS) if wanted.

items.name: Open Topo Data
items.why: 'Steep walk' hints in hilly cities like Lisbon.

items.name: India Public Holidays
items.why: Covers India's moving holidays; mirror into the DB.

items.name: Wikidata
items.why: Seed a static table of plugs, driving side, emergency numbers; check by hand.

items.name: REST Countries
items.why: v3.1 deprecated; v5 needs a key; free plan non-commercial; 3-day cache cap.
items.terms: 'Free plan is intended for … non-commercial use' (verified)

items.name: caldays
items.why: Returns 2026 for any year asked, without an error.

items.name: OSRM demo server
items.why: 'foot' returns car routes; non-commercial only.

items.name: Pirate Weather
items.why: Personal use only; now needs a key (list says none); doc link 404.

items.name: Tomorrow.io, Weatherbit, Weatherstack, 7Timer!
items.why: Free tiers ban commercial use.

items.name: APIXU, Meltema
items.why: APIXU is dead (redirects to Weatherstack); Meltema timed out.

items.name: WeatherAPI.com, Visual Crossing, OpenWeatherMap
items.why: Keys; caching or storage limits; MET Norway does the job free.

items.name: Mapbox (geocoding, directions)
items.why: Project rule (D6): never store Mapbox results; Navigation results can't be cached.

items.name: Google Maps APIs
items.why: Paid; no caching; not allowed near a non-Google map (MapLibre). Keep the free 'Open in Google Maps' link.

items.name: GraphHopper, Stadia, TomTom, HERE
items.why: Non-commercial free tiers, caching bans or proprietary data.

items.name: Photon (komoot)
items.why: 4.8–12.2 s responses today; fair-use only.

items.name: Yelp, Tripadvisor
items.why: Yelp is trial then $229/mo; Tripadvisor Content API deprecated, successor bans caching. Places come from FSQ OS anyway (D6).

items.name: Ticketmaster, Eventbrite, SeatGeek, PredictHQ
items.why: Ticketmaster bars deriving revenue; Eventbrite search shut 2019; others keyed or paid.

items.name: Amadeus, Sabre, flight price APIs
items.why: Flights search is a non-goal; 'Find flights' links to Google Flights (Q38).

items.name: Can I enter, Orizn Visa
items.why: Visa paperwork is out of scope (D10); data trust is partial.

items.name: Microlink, LinkPreview, Scrappa, Serply
items.why: Fetch or scrape third-party pages. Project rule: no scraping; use official oEmbed only.

items.name: Teleport, WorldTimeAPI, Warnely, Graph Countries
items.why: Dead or down today (DNS gone, unreachable, 404, 503).

items.name: LibreTranslate public instance
items.why: Now needs a key.

items.name: IP geolocation APIs (40+)
items.why: Not needed: home city is a profile setting; near-me uses the device location on demand.
